review_outcome: Admission-ready for one new physical campus in Germany. A dated, in-window first-party statement by one of the two equal joint-venture shareholders says the Lahr data centre is being built. The operator's own pages give its exact site address, and Baden-Württemberg's official INSPIRE address service supplies a single address position for that address, transformed once from native ETRS89 / UTM 32N.

lifecycle_review.route: EWM's public press page for the 2026 results press conference, dated 19. Juni 2026, links the release PDF. No login, form or token is involved.
lifecycle_review.finding: Release page 5, section 'Rechenzentren Appenweier und Lahr': the joint venture's first centre in Appenweier reached full utilization in early 2025, so the second, in Lahr, could start in 2025. The Lahr centre is being built, AI-ready. Works began in June 2025, and completion and commissioning are planned for 2027.
lifecycle_review.status_wording_review: The selected sentence uses the present passive 'wird ... gebaut' (is being built) together with an AI-ready design claim. It is accepted as a broad current-construction statement because the same section reports that works began in June 2025 and that completion, planned for 2027, has not occurred. This matches the envia Leipzig ('currently being expanded') and STACK ('construction is underway') precedents. The AI-ready claim is not normalized.
lifecycle_review.date_semantics: June 19 is the release's own date and dateline. The status is publication-normalized, not an inspection or start day. The June 2025 start predates the window and is not selected. September and October retrievals do not refresh the date.
lifecycle_review.authority: Elektrizitätswerk Mittelbaden AG & Co. KG is a first-party source: its August 4, 2025 release states that it and the Q-FOX group each hold 50% of LEITWERK Rechenzentren Appenweier/Lahr GmbH.
lifecycle_review.same_day_hosting_page: Round42 capture of the results page (sha256 c1d22cb1e0b63b1434e339edf22ddabc3166e3c03c29a030272b84e6c6a812d8) carries the same paragraphs and links the PDF. The round43 recapture (sha256 f29c89dba434cf00b3c52ab17b92a86b053d91e3cac08d0900964917c2e23b73) differs only in one site-wide navigation label.
predecessors: EWM August 4, 2025: the joint venture is building the Lahr 'twin' of Appenweier on the startkLahr Airport & Business Park Raum Lahr (round42 sha256 a28045d068430cafb09f12a7d07d3f0dcdf71520a74a1969dd4d1ce1b3eea6c1). Stale; identity only.
LEITWERK August 4, 2025 blog: construction of the region's largest data centre begins (round42 sha256 bb5cd3358f15a76c88bbd0949f1012b0088e362c87c58e036b48978854121c56). Stale; not selected.

EWM May 12, 2026: topping-out ceremony with the shell complete and operation planned for 2027 (round42 sha256 33eae6b7b09a59f23038830bdbc5a3759873733b096ffa0c20051a9023f82149). Ten days before the window; not selected.
lifecycle_review.in_window_corroboration_not_selected: LEITWERK's June 29, 2026 press note (round42 sha256 3495afa3135af48d41b54aac0abeb2a65382883106d9752787cc631b4ef8b5aa) refers readers to a trade-magazine article and carries a photo whose alternative text describes the Lahr construction status in June 2026. As with the Vantage Frontier hold, a dated photo caption is not selected, and the photo is not imagery evidence.
lifecycle_review.successor_review: Through August 20, no completion, opening, cancellation or legal stop was found. EWM's press index, pages 1 and 2 (captured 2026-10-09; sha256 51cac4ea1c49d2315227314fcad3790c1137987a2d97171cfd782d43e5b2abbb and e60c56f7ac4dee263e50cfe66d5de9c37af889266c2e81e3c9d29d83432abde2), runs from the May 12 topping-out to the June 19 results, then only unrelated July 2 and July 21 items. LEITWERK's press list (sha256 5f0906cd7e91f8f328f90ecd4b743a055a78c8149605fc823561e210ef78c596) has no completion item; its September 24 note on a trade article is illustrated with a construction-progress image. Post-window pages still describe a construction site: open construction-site days on November 5 and December 3, 2026, and planned certification of the new centre from 2027.
lifecycle_review.scope: Broad project under_construction only. The pre-window topping-out is not converted into a finer stage, and no IT area, rack count, capacity, workload, tenant or operating model is normalized.
lifecycle_review.absence_limit: Bounded first-party and press-index review, not an exhaustive permit, court or site-inspection audit.

identity_review.joint_venture: LEITWERK Rechenzentren Appenweier/Lahr GmbH, owned in equal shares by Elektrizitätswerk Mittelbaden AG & Co. KG and the Q-FOX group (which includes LEITWERK AG). It markets services under the BADEN CLOUD brand (EWM August 4, 2025 release).
identity_review.campus: The joint venture's second data centre, 'Rechenzentrum Lahr', on the startkLahr Airport & Business Park Raum Lahr. The first centre, in Appenweier, is a separate operating site and is neither selected nor merged.
identity_review.address_bridge: The Q-FOX open construction-site day page names the venue 'Rechenzentrum Lahr, Einsteinallee 14, 77933 Lahr', with a guided tour of the construction site (round42 sha256 8334e3555e8c2a453d34c501812791735e6a5d911577093a04520de7307b95f5). LEITWERK's BADEN CLOUD page for the new Lahr centre gives the same location (round42 sha256 ee616d7b54fd0c47f88a3035ad41a8cecb754ade682fa2bca00b3868407ebedc). As with the envia Leipzig event-venue precedent, these undated first-party pages supply the address only, not lifecycle status.
identity_review.excluded_addresses: The joint venture's registered seats at Im Ettenbach 13a, Appenweier and Lotzbeckstraße 45, Lahr (EWM's own address in its legal notice) are corporate addresses, not the site. Several logistics premises also use Einsteinallee addresses; only the exact house number 14 is used.
aliases: startkLahr Airport & Business Park Raum Lahr

independent_geometry_review.feature: ad:Address gml:id Address.DEBWhx01000s9CqQ (INSPIRE id https://registry.gdi-de.org/id/de.bw.lgl/Address_DEBWhx01000s9CqQ): house number 14, ThoroughfareName.0831706583002 resolved to Einsteinallee, PostalDescriptor.77933 resolved to 77933 Lahr/Schwarzwald, AdminUnitName.08317065 resolved to the municipality Lahr/Schwarzwald.
independent_geometry_review.native_crs: EPSG:25832 (ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N), the ad:Address DefaultCRS in the capabilities; EPSG:25833 and EPSG:4258 are the only advertised alternatives.
independent_geometry_review.transformation: pyproj 3.7.1 / PROJ 9.5.1 'Inverse of UTM zone 32N + ETRS89 to WGS 84 (1)', the only candidate with allow_ballpark=False; operation accuracy 1 m; always_xy.
independent_geometry_review.server_crosscheck: The service's own EPSG:4258 output, 48.362257 N 7.816992 E, differs by 0.005 m (six-decimal serialization). It is not selected.
independent_geometry_review.unadvertised_4326: The round42 query requested EPSG:4326, which the service does not advertise; the response repeats the ETRS89 digits under a 4326 label and is not used as a CRS-handled source.
independent_geometry_review.uniqueness: A wide query (78 addresses, below the COUNT limit of 5000) contains 24 Einsteinallee addresses, at least about 360 m inside every edge of the query box, and exactly one house number 14.
independent_geometry_review.point_semantics: INSPIRE specification 'building' (the position aims at identifying the related building) and method 'byAdministrator' (decided and recorded by the official body or custodian). It is an address position for the campus, not a footprint, parcel or work extent.
independent_geometry_review.uncertainty_caveat: No positional accuracy is published for individual points. The 1 m operation accuracy is not the point's accuracy.

round43_lane_holds.candidate: Landkreis Emsland county data centre with offices, Kreishaus Meppen
round43_lane_holds.finding: The county's 03.07.2026 release (round42 sha256 0d6408bfb438018f194479959b8a4768a80172198f6786027ba8706b400c0b32) reports earth being moved, the building being built and construction begun in mid-June. However, the only official locator is ALKIS parcel Meppen Flur 7 Flurstück 19/5 (53,271 m2, location text 'Ordeniederung 1'). That parcel is the whole county-headquarters property, not a project-specific locator, and the roughly 250 m2 annex sits behind the Kreishaus. The release URL now returns 404 after a site relaunch. See the separate hold note.

round43_lane_holds.candidate: YEXIO Herne (FunkenbergQuartier) and NTT Berlin, from the HOCHTIEF half-year report

Neither is an in-window observation of ongoing work. See the separate hold note.

separate_unfinished_work: The inherited CGK host-estate locator still requires a versioned correction before a verified 200-site completion claim. This proposal does not alter it.
